rule: label-free method and N with the highest mean macro-F1 on d3m_test over three draws, Phase 1 maize model
application: Notebook 11: the Phase 1 maize model is adapted once with this method and N on images drawn from d5_adapt with the draw-1 seed rule of Notebook 09, then scored on the sealed d5_test; draws 2 and 3 are reported as sensitivity. Primary endpoint: paired group-bootstrap difference in macro-F1 (M01, M05) versus the unadapted Phase 1 model; confirmed if the 95% interval excludes zero and the estimate is >= +0.02.

method_settings.adabn: running-average BN statistics over batches of 32
method_settings.tent: AdaBN then 5 epochs, Adam 1e-3, BN scale/shift only
method_settings.self_training: two rounds; accept if max temperature-scaled probability >= Phase 1 threshold; 10 epochs Adam 1e-4 on final blocks + head, Phase 1 augmentation
